materiality: ROCM_AITER_FA could pass stale non-neutral K/V scale tensors as descales even when the KV cache was unquantized, corrupting attention output.

Upstream reproduced a post-reload MI300X InfoVQA collapse from the expected 0.952 to 0.000 and reports recovery to 0.952 after the repair, making this a correctness boundary rather than routine backend churn.
upstreamEvidenceBounds: Upstream reports one targeted ROCm backend test passing on MI300X plus a 4/4 InfoVQA reproduction with successful CUDA graph recaptures.
Those results are upstream evidence only and do not qualify other ROCm devices, cache precisions, AITER revisions, model families, reload paths, or SZL runtime composition.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact vLLM source/wheel/container digest, AITER revision/build, ROCm/driver/compiler, device SKU/topology, exact model/tokenizer/processor bytes, KV-cache dtype and every attention/backend flag.

Add an independent deterministic negative fixture with deliberately non-neutral stale scale tensors proving unquantized caches ignore descales while FP8 caches continue to consume the intended scales.

Exercise initial load, dummy-weight initialization, real-weight reload, CUDA-graph recapture, eager execution, sliding-window cache and representative concurrency; compare logits or deterministic task outputs to an independent reference/backend.
Require a known-bad predecessor control when executable so the sentinel demonstrates it can detect the failure rather than merely recording a healthy candidate score.
Keep non-executed hardware/configuration lanes UNAVAILABLE or UNQUALIFIED and preserve rollback to the incumbent exact runtime.

materiality: The KDA prefill path wrote shared memory through the generic proxy and consumed it through tcgen05 async machinery without the required proxy fence, allowing a hardware ordering race on SM103.

Upstream A/B stress evidence reports large mismatch rates for the unfenced path and zero mismatches for the fenced path across the exercised shapes; incorrect output or device faults are therefore possible without the repair.
upstreamEvidenceBounds: Upstream reports B300/SM103 A/B stress evidence: fenced 0/100 mismatches in each tested shape while the deliberately unfenced variant mismatched frequently.
Upstream explicitly notes a CPU test cannot exercise this hardware memory-ordering rule and a race-provocation regression is nondeterministic; its CI state is not an SZL hardware receipt.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact SGLang/JIT source, emitted kernel/module digest, CUDA/driver/compiler/toolchain identity and exact SM103 device topology.

Use a deterministic structural/kernel witness proving fence.proxy.async.shared::cta exists at the required ordering point, then pair it with bounded repeated hardware stress using fixed inputs and a separately computed reference result.

Record mismatch distributions and device-fault outcomes for candidate and an intentionally fence-removed negative control built from the same source boundary; do not turn probabilistic absence of a race into PASS by itself.
Exercise all admitted KDA prefill shapes/prefix-composition paths, worker restart, cancellation and CUDA graph/eager modes that reach the kernel; unexecuted paths remain UNQUALIFIED.
Preserve rollback and do not claim performance improvement because upstream makes no speed claim.

materiality: HiCache host backup/restore for MXFP8 KV payloads previously omitted the separate UE8M0 scale buffers and undercounted host-pool bytes, so restored pages could use unrelated device-row scales.
The repair adds an MXFP8-aware host pool, transfers scale bytes with payload state, accounts for their capacity, and rejects unsupported layout/storage combinations instead of silently proceeding.
upstreamEvidenceBounds: Upstream reports bit-exact payload+scale D2H/H2D round trips and shape-matched host-restore versus device-hit output with zero per-token logprob difference on its tested four-rank setup.
Upstream base CI was green but extra/AMD lanes were not fully green in the PR state; no throughput claim was made and no SZL qualification is inherited.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact SGLang/JIT source and runtime image, accelerator/runtime identities, KV format/layout, page size, HiCache settings and exact model/tokenizer source.

Add deterministic payload-and-scale round-trip fixtures with poisoned destination scale rows so a missing scale restore cannot accidentally pass; verify host-pool byte accounting and capacity boundaries independently.
Prove unsupported page layout, I/O backend, scale layout and L3 flat-page operations fail explicitly rather than falling back to lossy storage behavior.
Run fixed-seed device-hit versus host-restore token/logit parity through eviction, repeated restore, mixed batches, cancellation and worker restart on every hardware lane actually admitted.
Preserve existing non-MXFP8 HiCache behavior and rollback; benchmark overhead only after correctness is closed.
